defs.def: a person who owns or manages a farm 农场主；农人

ex.s: While farmer’s markets are a solid choice to reduce the journey, Babylon Micro-Farm (BMF) shortens it even more.
ex.t: 虽然农贸市场是缩短路程的不错选择，但Babylon Micro-Farm（BMF）把它缩得更短。

ex.s: It relies on farmer’s markets.
ex.t: 它依赖农贸市场。

ex.s: Farmers in east-central Alberta.
ex.t: 阿尔伯塔省中东部的农民。

ex.s: The local farmers’ advocates.
ex.t: 当地农民的拥护者。

ex.s: It helps local farmers grow fruits.
ex.t: 它帮助当地农民种植水果。

ex.s: The amazing food is mainly consumed by local farmers.
ex.t: E.这不是法国人比我们吃得少的唯一原因。

ex.s: The summer before my eighth grade I was one of a group of boys that a neighboring farmer hired to work in his field.
ex.t: 八年级前的那个夏天我和一群男孩一起被一位邻近的农民雇用到他的田里干活。

ex.s: After a short way, the farmer stopped and pointed at a weed which we missed.
ex.t: 走了一小段路后，农场主停下来，指着我们漏掉的一株杂草。

ex.s: My labors lasted about two weeks, and the farmer said there might be more work, but I wasn’t interested.
ex.t: 我的劳动持续了大约两周农夫说可能还有更多的工作但我不再感兴趣了。

ex.s: Nutria were brought there from Argentina by fur farmers and let go into the wild.
ex.t: 海狸鼠是由皮草养殖户从阿根廷带来后被放归野外的。

ex.s: “I don’t really mind it,” Emil Norby told Modern Farmer magazine.
ex.t: “我并不真的介意，”埃米尔·诺比告诉《现代农民》杂志。

ex.s: 31 For example, farmers, who produce the food we eat, use water to make the plants grow.
ex.t: 31 例如，生产我们所吃食物的农民需要用水让庄稼生长。

ex.s: A local farmer told them the dog sounded like one   50   as lost in the local paper.
ex.t: 一位当地农夫告诉他们，这只狗听起来像是当地报纸上报道过____50____丢失的那只。

ex.s: Soon afterwards, many of those people started settling down to become farmers, and their languages too became more settled and fewer in number.
ex.t: 不久之后，那些人中的许多开始定居下来成为农民，他们的语言也随之变得更加稳定，数量也减少了。

ex.s: Another reason for corn’s rise: The government encourages farmers to grow corn instead of rice   64   (improve) water quality.
ex.t: 玉米崛起的另一个原因：政府鼓励农民种玉米而非水稻，____64____（改善）水质。

ex.s: The Chinese Ministry of Agriculture finds that between 2005 – when the government   68   (start) a soil – testing program   69   gives specific fertilizer recommendations to farmers – and 2011, fertilizer use dropped by 7.7 million tons.
ex.t: 中国农业部发现，在2005年（政府___68___ start一项为农民提供具体施肥建议的测土配方项目）至2011年间，化肥使用量下降了770万吨。

ex.s: Many farmers opposed the plan because they feared that wolves would kill their farm animals or pets.
ex.t: 许多农民反对这项计划，因为他们担心狼会杀死他们的农场动物或宠物。

ex.s: The conflict between farmers and gray wolves.
ex.t: 农民与灰狼之间的冲突。

ex.s: But he is providing a few years during which the farmers will, perhaps, be able to find other means of adapting.
ex.t: 但他争取到了几年时间，农民或许能在其间找到其他的适应办法。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: Farmers in many countries are also adapting like this—either by growing new produce, or by growing the same things differently.
ex.t: 许多国家的农民也在这样适应——要么种植新的农产品，要么用不同的方式种植同样的东西。

ex.s: It works to help farmers and workers in less developed areas receive a better deal for their produce.
ex.t: 它致力于帮助欠发达地区的农民和工人为自己的产品获得更公平的待遇。

ex.s: However, no one in modern times knew about the tomb or the terracotta statues until 1974, when some farmers discovered the tomb while they were digging a well!
ex.t: 然而，直到 1974 年，现代人才知道这座陵墓和兵马俑的存在，当时一些农民在挖井时发现了这座陵墓！

ex.s: In the 1950s, the Egyptian government wanted to build a new dam across the Nile in order to control floods, produce electricity, and supply water to more farmers in the area.
ex.t: 20世纪50年代，埃及政府想在尼罗河上建一座新水坝，以控制洪水、发电，并为当地更多农民供水。

ex.s: She was the daughter of a local farmer.
ex.t: 她是当地一个农民的女儿。

ex.s: After careful analysis, the scientists can provide useful recommendations and advice for farmers.
ex.t: 经过仔细分析，科学家们可以为农民提供有用的建议和意见。
